purpose: Make manifest tuples, CAS, genesis, outbox, replay, drain, and quarantine authoritative.
rules: The 267 canonical transition tuples are the sole runtime transition authority.
Every state change validates expected revision, product state, participants, guards, input digest, and idempotency.
Commit event, state, semantic cursor, and exact outbox in one durable replacement.
Replay identical bytes; reject changed bytes under a reused identity.
Scope quarantine to the smallest unverifiable object and preserve unrelated liveness.
